title: A Continual Learning Framework for Adaptive Control of Modular Soft Robots
summary: Soft robots have attracted significant attention in applications such as medical intervention, rehabilitation, and robotic manipulation due to their inherent compliance, flexibility, and high degrees of freedom. Modular soft robots (MSRs), composed of multiple interconnected segments, represent an emerging class of robotic systems with highly deformable and reconfigurable structures capable of performing complex tasks. However, designing controllers for MSRs remains challenging due to their nonlinear dynamics, modeling complexity, and hyper-redundant nature. Existing approaches typically require controllers to be retrained from scratch whenever the robot morphology changes. In this work, we address these challenges through a continual learning inspired control framework capable of incrementally adapting to changes in robot morphology while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Specifically, the proposed framework enables the controller to sequentially learn new MSR configurations without forgetting previously learned ones. In addition, for MSRs with fixed configurations, the same framework can be employed in a distributed manner to learn module-specific dynamics, enabling localized control and improved precision. The proposed approach is validated through closed-loop trajectory tracking experiments in simulation using a tendon-driven soft robot, as well as on a real-world three-module pneumatic soft robotic arm. Furthermore, we demonstrate the adaptive capabilities of the framework through a reaching experiment in which the controller selectively activates only the necessary modules to reach a virtual target position, thereby reducing computational overhead.
tldr: This paper proposes a continual learning framework for adaptive control of modular soft robots, enabling incremental adaptation to morphology changes without forgetting prior knowledge, validated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模块化软机器人的持续学习控制框架，能够在不遗忘先前知识的情况下逐步适应形态变化，并通过仿真和真实实验验证。
summary_zh: 软体机器人因其固有的柔顺性、灵活性和高自由度，在医疗干预、康复和机器人操作等应用中受到了广泛关注。模块化软体机器人（MSRs）由多个相互连接的段组成，代表了一类具有高度变形和可重构结构的新型机器人系统，能够执行复杂任务。然而，由于MSRs的非线性动力学、建模复杂性和超冗余特性，为其设计控制器仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常要求每当机器人形态发生变化时，控制器需从头开始重新训练。在本工作中，我们通过一种受持续学习启发的控制框架来应对这些挑战，该框架能够逐步适应机器人形态的变化，同时保留先前获取的知识。具体而言，所提出的框架使控制器能够顺序学习新的MSR配置，而不会遗忘先前学到的知识。此外，对于固定配置的MSR，同一框架可以以分布式方式使用，以学习模块特定的动力学，从而实现局部控制并提高精度。所提出的方法通过使用腱驱动软体机器人的仿真闭环轨迹跟踪实验，以及真实世界中的三模块气动软体机械臂进行了验证。此外，我们通过一个到达实验展示了该框架的自适应能力：在该实验中，控制器仅选择性地激活必要的模块以到达虚拟目标位置，从而降低了计算开销。

title: Context-Aware Force Estimation for Deformable Tool Manipulation in Robotic Environmental Swabbing via Few-Shot Continual Adaptation
summary: Robotic surface swabbing requires sustained interaction between a compliant tool and heterogeneous environments, where accurate estimation of tip-level contact force is critical for consistent sampling performance. However, deformable tool dynamics introduce nonlinear viscoelastic hysteresis that decouples wrist-mounted force measurements from true contact forces, while tool-integrated sensors are impractical for deployment due to sterility and disposability constraints. This paper presents a data-driven framework for contact force estimation in Deformable Tool Manipulation (DTM) that leverages proprioceptive sensing without requiring explicit physical models or permanent embedded sensing hardware at the tool tip. A recurrent architecture is first identified through a comparative evaluation of temporal models, where a compact LSTM achieves the lowest estimation error and sub-millisecond inference latency. To address generalization across unseen surfaces and tool compliance conditions, we introduce a parameter-isolated few-shot adaptation strategy that augments a frozen recurrent backbone with low-dimensional context embeddings using feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). Experiments on a UR5e platform across nine tool-surface interaction regimes demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves robustness under domain shift, reducing zero-shot estimation error by up to 63\% while preserving baseline performance without catastrophic forgetting. These results show that separating shared deformation-history dynamics from domain-specific conditioning enables reliable force estimation for DTM in non-stationary environments.
tldr: A data-driven framework using a compact LSTM with few-shot continual adaptation (FiLM) estimates tip-level contact force for deformable tools in robotic environmental swabbing, reducing zero-shot estimation error by 63% without catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 一个数据驱动框架，使用紧凑型LSTM和少样本持续适应（FiLM），估计机器人环境擦拭中可变形工具的尖端接触力，将零样本估计误差降低63%，且不会灾难性遗忘。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人表面擦拭要求在柔性工具与异质环境之间维持持续交互，其中精确估计尖端接触力对于实现一致的采样性能至关重要。然而，可变形工具动力学引入了非线性粘弹性滞后，使得腕部安装的力传感器测量值与实际接触力之间产生解耦，而工具集成式传感器因无菌性和一次性使用的限制而难以实际部署。本文提出了一种数据驱动的接触力估计框架，适用于可变形工具操作（DTM），该框架利用本体感觉传感，无需显式物理模型或工具尖端的永久嵌入式传感硬件。通过对时序模型的比较评估，首先确定了一种循环架构，其中紧凑型LSTM实现了最低的估计误差和亚毫秒级推理延迟。为解决在未见表面和工具顺应性条件下的泛化问题，我们引入了一种参数隔离的少样本适应策略，该策略通过特征线性调制（FiLM）利用低维上下文嵌入来增强冻结的循环骨干网络。在UR5e平台上进行了九种工具-表面交互机制的实验，结果表明，所提出的方法显著提升了域迁移下的鲁棒性，将零样本估计误差降低了高达63%，同时在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下保持了基线性能。这些结果表明，将共享的变形历史动态与领域特定条件分离，能够在非平稳环境中实现可靠的DTM力估计。

title: AA-ViT: Anatomically Aware Vision Transformer with Structural and Frequency Guidance for Contrast Enhanced Brain MRI Synthesis
summary: Accurate tumour localization and diagnosis is a critical component of clinical care for brain cancers. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the most commonly used imaging modality due to its superior soft-tissue contrast. However, standard MRI often exhibits limited contrast and imaging artifacts, which necessitates the use of contrast agents to enhance lesion visibility. The administration of chemical contrast agents is not always feasible and may be contraindicated in patients with renal impairment or other health conditions. As a result, developing accurate and non-invasive contrast enhanced MRI (CEMRI) synthesis methods has clinical importance. In recent years, numerous approaches for CEMRI synthesis have been proposed, predominantly relying on generative artificial intelligence models. While these methods demonstrate promising performance, their dependence on implicit feature learning often limits their ability to preserve anatomical boundaries and tumour-specific fine structures. To address these challenges, we propose an anatomically aware frequency-and-structure-guided vision transformer (AA-ViT), for CEMRI synthesis using pre-contrast MRI modalities (T1, T2, and FLAIR). Experiments on the BraTS 2021 dataset demonstrate that the proposed method preserves anatomical and lesion boundaries, achieving higher PSNR and SSIM than state-of-the-art approaches. Clinical evaluation by three neuroradiologists and a neurosurgeon on 19 randomly selected cases across diverse gliomas yielded a mean score of 3.94/5, providing preliminary clinical validation rarely seen in prior studies. Synthetic post-contrast scans from our model could lower scanning costs, shorten imaging time, and avoid the potential risks of using gadolinium-based contrast agents.
tldr: AA-ViT is an anatomically aware vision transformer that uses structural and frequency guidance to synthesize contrast-enhanced MRI from non-contrast scans, achieving higher quality metrics and clinical validation on brain tumor cases.
tldr_zh: AA-ViT是一种解剖感知的视觉Transformer，利用结构和频率引导从非增强扫描合成对比增强MRI，在脑肿瘤病例中取得了更高的质量指标和临床验证。
summary_zh: 准确的肿瘤定位与诊断是脑癌临床治疗中的关键环节。磁共振成像（MRI）因其优异的软组织对比度而成为最常用的成像方式。然而，标准MRI常存在对比度有限和成像伪影的问题，这需要使用对比剂来增强病灶可视性。化学对比剂的给药并非总是可行，且对于肾功能不全或其他健康问题的患者可能存在禁忌。因此，开发准确且无创的对比增强MRI（CEMRI）合成方法具有重要的临床意义。近年来，已提出了多种CEMRI合成方法，主要依赖于生成式人工智能模型。尽管这些方法展现出令人鼓舞的性能，但它们对隐式特征学习的依赖往往限制了其保留解剖边界和肿瘤特异性精细结构的能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种解剖感知的频率与结构引导的视觉变换器（AA-ViT），用于利用平扫MRI模态（T1、T2和FLAIR）合成CEMRI。在BraTS 2021数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法保留了解剖和病灶边界，在PSNR和SSIM指标上均优于现有最先进方法。由三位神经放射科医生和一位神经外科医生对19例随机选取的不同胶质瘤病例进行的临床评估给出了平均3.94/5分的评分，这提供了以往研究中罕见的初步临床验证。我们的模型生成的合成增强后扫描可降低扫描成本、缩短成像时间，并避免使用钆基对比剂的潜在风险。

title: SHTA: Semantic Hard Token Correction and Center Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in semi-supervised medical image segmentation have achieved remarkable performance through prediction consistency, pseudo-label supervision, and hard-region supervision. However, these methods primarily improve supervision quality rather than explicitly enforcing semantic consistency in the learned representations of hard regions. Consequently, even under increasingly stronger prediction-level supervision, difficult regions exhibiting unstable semantic assignment often fail to establish semantically consistent representations during training, thereby limiting further segmentation improvement. To address this issue, we propose SHTA (Semantic Hard Token Correction and Center Alignment), a lightweight training-time semantic representation branch. Instead of introducing additional prediction supervision, SHTA refines intermediate semantic representations through Semantic Assignment, Hard Token Refinement, and Semantic Center Alignment, thereby improving semantic consistency in hard regions while preserving the original prediction pathway and introducing no additional inference cost. We integrate SHTA into representative semi-supervised segmentation frameworks, including GA-CPS, CPS, URPC, and MagicNet, and conduct evaluations on the Synapse and AMOS datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that SHTA delivers consistent paired improvements across frameworks, with especially clear gains in segmentation accuracy, weak-organ recovery, and semantic ambiguity reduction, while incurring only training-time overhead. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/release_SHTA-42D5/.
tldr: Proposes SHTA, a lightweight training-time semantic representation branch for semi-supervised medical image segmentation that improves semantic consistency in hard regions via semantic assignment, hard token refinement, and center alignment, achieving consistent segmentation gains across multiple frameworks without extra inference cost.
tldr_zh: 提出SHTA，一种轻量级的训练时语义表示分支，通过语义分配、困难标记修正和语义中心对齐来提高半监督医学图像分割中困难区域的语义一致性，在不增加推理成本的情况下，在多个框架上实现一致的分割性能提升。
summary_zh: 半监督医学图像分割的最新进展通过预测一致性、伪标签监督和困难区域监督取得了显著性能。然而，这些方法主要提升监督质量，而非显式地在困难区域的学习表示中强制语义一致性。因此，即使在越来越强的预测级监督下，表现出不稳定语义分配的困难区域也常常无法在训练过程中建立语义一致的表示，从而限制了分割性能的进一步提升。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SHTA（语义困难令牌修正与中心对齐），一个轻量级的训练时语义表示分支。SHTA不引入额外的预测监督，而是通过语义分配、困难令牌修正和语义中心对齐来优化中间语义表示，从而在保持原始预测路径且不增加推理成本的同时，提升困难区域的语义一致性。我们将SHTA集成到具有代表性的半监督分割框架中，包括GA-CPS、CPS、URPC和MagicNet，并在Synapse和AMOS数据集上进行评估。实验结果表明，SHTA在不同框架中均带来一致的成对改进，在分割精度、弱器官恢复和语义模糊减少方面尤为显著，且仅增加训练时间开销。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/release_SHTA-42D5/获取。

title: A hierarchical memory architecture overcomes context limits in long-horizon multi-agent computational modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet their stateless architecture fundamentally limits deployment in long-horizon research workflows requiring multi-session continuity and quantitative rigor. Here we present Ensemble QSP, a multi-agent framework featuring a three-layer hierarchical memory architecture that keeps injected context bounded and constant in project duration (mid-term project state: median 301 tokens, max 4,050, across 104 runs) by capping each state category and evicting completed work, enabling continuous autonomous operation without context degradation. The system orchestrates five specialist worker agents under domain-expert principal investigators, enforcing physical constraints through physics-based checklists and structured-domain knowledge. Comprehensive benchmarking demonstrates robust autonomous pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic model selection without human intervention, consistent result quality across both lower-cost and frontier LLMs, improved PK parameter recovery relative to single-agent baselines, and stable model selection across linguistically diverse prompts of the same task. Feature-level ablation across physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models spanning a broad complexity range shows that PI-agent oversight improves debugging efficiency while preserving final accuracy across conditions. The architecture is structurally domain-agnostic, adding a new scientific domain requires only a new PI agent configuration.
tldr: This paper introduces Ensemble QSP, a multi-agent framework with a three-layer hierarchical memory architecture that keeps context bounded and constant, enabling continuous autonomous operation for long-horizon scientific modeling tasks such as pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic model selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Ensemble QSP，一种具有三层分层记忆架构的多智能体框架，该架构保持上下文受限且恒定，从而实现长期自主运行，适用于药代动力学-药效学模型选择等科学建模任务。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现了卓越的推理能力，但其无状态架构从根本上限制了其在需要多会话连续性和定量严谨性的长周期研究工作流中的部署。本文提出Ensemble QSP，一个多智能体框架，其采用三层分层记忆架构，通过限制每个状态类别并驱逐已完成工作，使注入的上下文在项目周期内保持有界且恒定（中期项目状态：中位数301个令牌，最大值4,050个令牌，共104次运行），从而在没有上下文退化的情况下实现连续自主运行。该系统在领域专家首席研究员的指导下协调五个专业工作智能体，通过基于物理的检查清单和结构化领域知识强制执行物理约束。全面的基准测试表明：无需人工干预即可实现鲁棒的自主动药代动力学-药效学模型选择；在低成本模型和前沿LLM上均获得一致的结果质量；相对于单智能体基线，PK参数恢复能力得到改善；对于同一任务的语言多样化提示，模型选择保持稳定。在涵盖广泛复杂度范围的基于生理的药代动力学（PBPK）模型上进行的特征级消融实验显示，PI智能体的监督提高了调试效率，同时在不同条件下保持了最终准确性。该架构在结构上独立于具体领域，添加一个新的科学领域仅需配置新的PI智能体。
